why: All figures are a rectangle with a V-shaped notch near one end of a long side. Options 1-4 are the same shape turned around. In option 5 the notch is near the other end of the long side, so it is a mirror image.
trick: Note which corner the notch is closest to; a rotation keeps that, a mirror image does not.
